description: This file contains extension methods for configuring the Help Page in an ASP.NET Web API project, including setting documentation providers, sample requests/responses, and generating API models for help pages.

classes.name: HelpPageConfigurationExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring help page documentation, samples, and API models in ASP.NET Web API.

methods.name: SetDocumentationProvider
methods.description: Sets the documentation provider for the help page.

methods.name: SetSampleObjects
methods.description: Sets sample objects used by formatters for producing sample requests and responses.

methods.name: SetSampleRequest
methods.description: Sets a sample request for a specific media type and action.

methods.name: SetSampleRequest (with parameters)
methods.description: Sets a sample request with specific parameters for a media type and action.

methods.name: SetSampleResponse
methods.description: Sets a sample response for a specific media type and action.

methods.name: SetSampleResponse (with parameters)
methods.description: Sets a sample response with specific parameters for a media type and action.

methods.name: SetSampleForMediaType
methods.description: Sets a sample for all actions with a specific media type.

methods.name: SetSampleForType
methods.description: Sets a sample for all actions with a specific type and media type.

methods.name: SetActualRequestType
methods.description: Specifies the actual request message type for an action.

methods.name: SetActualRequestType (with parameters)
methods.description: Specifies the actual request message type for an action with parameters.

methods.name: SetActualResponseType
methods.description: Specifies the actual response message type for an action.

methods.name: SetActualResponseType (with parameters)
methods.description: Specifies the actual response message type for an action with parameters.

methods.name: GetHelpPageSampleGenerator
methods.description: Retrieves the help page sample generator from the configuration.

methods.name: SetHelpPageSampleGenerator
methods.description: Sets the help page sample generator in the configuration.

methods.name: GetHelpPageApiModel
methods.description: Retrieves or generates the API model for a specific API description ID.
